title: Безличный пассив: It is said that… / He is said to have…

why: Эта конструкция нужна, когда мы передаём общее мнение, слухи или новости, не называя, кто именно это говорит: «говорят, что…», «считается, что…», «ожидается, что…». По-русски это безличные предложения, а в английском для них есть два готовых шаблона. Их очень любят в новостях и в деловой речи.
formation: • Шаблон 1: It is + V3 + that + целое предложение. It is said that he is rich.
• Шаблон 2: Подлежащее + is/are + V3 + to + глагол. He is said to be rich.
• Одновременно с мнением или в будущем: to + базовая форма. She is believed to live in Paris.
• Действие раньше мнения: to have + V3. He is said to have won the prize.
• Действие идёт прямо сейчас: to be + V-ing. They are thought to be working abroad.
• Глаголы: say, believe, think, know, report, expect, consider, understand, claim.
usage: 1. Слухи и общее мнение: It is said that the CEO will leave. (Говорят, что директор уйдёт.) The CEO is said to be leaving. (Директор, как говорят, уходит.)
2. Новости и официальные сообщения: The minister is reported to have resigned. (Сообщается, что министр ушёл в отставку.)
3. Ожидания: The new phone is expected to be popular. (Ожидается, что новый телефон будет популярным.)
4. Прошлое событие: The house is known to have been built in 1900. (Известно, что дом построили в 1900 году.)
signalWords: is said, is believed, is thought, is known, is reported, is expected, is considered, is understood, is claimed. Перевод обычно начинается со слов «говорят», «считается», «полагают», «известно», «сообщается».
mistakes: ✗ It is said him to be rich → ✓ He is said to be rich / It is said that he is rich. Нельзя смешивать два шаблона.
✗ He is said that he is rich → ✓ It is said that he is rich. После that подлежащее «it», а не «he».
✗ People is said to be happy → ✓ People are said to be happy. Be должен согласоваться с подлежащим.
✗ He is said to win the prize last year → ✓ He is said to have won the prize last year. Для прошлого нужен to have + V3.
✗ He is know to be rich → ✓ He is known to be rich. Нужна третья форма глагола.
remember: Мнение в настоящем, а событие раньше — ставь to have + V3: He is said to have left.

items.prompt: It is ___ (say) that the company will hire more developers.
items.answer: said

items.prompt: The new phone is ___ (expect) to be very popular.
items.answer: expected

items.prompt: He is believed ___ (be) in Canada now.
items.answer: to be

items.prompt: She is said ___ (win) the prize last year.
items.answer: to have won

items.prompt: The bridge is known ___ (be) very old.
items.answer: to be

items.prompt: It ___ (report) that the meeting was cancelled.
items.answer: was reported / is reported

items.prompt: The thief is thought ___ (escape) through the window.
items.answer: to have escaped

items.prompt: The city is considered ___ (be) one of the safest in Europe.
items.answer: to be

items.prompt: It is believed (a) that he is (b) him to be (c) he to be a genius.
items.answer: (a) that he is

items.prompt: She is said (a) to speak (b) speaks (c) speaking five languages.
items.answer: (a) to speak

items.prompt: They are reported (a) to have left (b) to leave (c) have left the country last night.
items.answer: (a) to have left

items.prompt: It (a) says (b) is said (c) said that prices will rise.
items.answer: (b) is said

items.prompt: The company is expected (a) to announce (b) announcing (c) that announce new products soon.
items.answer: (a) to announce

items.prompt: He is thought (a) to have worked (b) to be working (c) to worked in Berlin right now.
items.answer: (b) to be working

items.prompt: The old man is said (a) to be (b) to have been very rich when he was young.
items.answer: (b) to have been

items.prompt: It (a) is believed (b) believe (c) believes that the fire started in the kitchen.
items.answer: (a) is believed

exercises.instruction: Перепишите предложение, начав с указанных слов

items.prompt: People say that Tom is a good manager. (Tom ...)
items.answer: Tom is said to be a good manager.

items.prompt: People believe that the virus came from animals. (The virus ...)
items.answer: The virus is believed to have come from animals.

items.prompt: They expect that prices will rise. (Prices ...)
items.answer: Prices are expected to rise.

items.prompt: People think that she is working abroad. (She ...)
items.answer: She is thought to be working abroad.

items.prompt: Everyone knows that he lost a lot of money. (He ...)
items.answer: He is known to have lost a lot of money.

items.prompt: They say that the film is excellent. (The film ...)
items.answer: The film is said to be excellent.

items.prompt: People report that the minister resigned. (The minister ...)
items.answer: The minister is reported to have resigned.

items.prompt: They consider that this method is safe. (This method ...)
items.answer: This method is considered to be safe. / This method is considered safe.

exercises.instruction: Перепишите предложение, начав с It is ...

items.prompt: He is said to be a millionaire.
items.answer: It is said that he is a millionaire.

items.prompt: The company is believed to have lost millions.
items.answer: It is believed that the company has lost millions. / It is believed that the company lost millions.

items.prompt: She is thought to live near the lake.
items.answer: It is thought that she lives near the lake.

items.prompt: The president is expected to arrive tomorrow.
items.answer: It is expected that the president will arrive tomorrow.

items.prompt: The house is known to have been built in 1900.
items.answer: It is known that the house was built in 1900. / It is known that the house had been built in 1900.

items.prompt: The suspect is reported to be in Spain.
items.answer: It is reported that the suspect is in Spain.

items.prompt: The team is understood to have fixed the bug.
items.answer: It is understood that the team has fixed the bug. / It is understood that the team fixed the bug.

items.prompt: He is considered to be the best developer.
items.answer: It is considered that he is the best developer.

items.prompt: Говорят, что этот ресторан очень дорогой.
items.answer: It is said that this restaurant is very expensive. / This restaurant is said to be very expensive.

items.prompt: Считается, что он лучший разработчик в нашей команде.
items.answer: He is considered to be the best developer in our team. / It is considered that he is the best developer in our team.

items.prompt: Говорят, что она живёт в Лондоне.
items.answer: She is said to live in London. / It is said that she lives in London.

items.prompt: Ожидается, что новая версия выйдет в следующем месяце.
items.answer: The new version is expected to be released next month. / It is expected that the new version will be released next month.

items.prompt: Полагают, что вор вошёл через окно.
items.answer: The thief is thought to have entered through the window. / It is thought that the thief entered through the window.

items.prompt: Известно, что эта компания теряет деньги.
items.answer: This company is known to be losing money. / It is known that this company is losing money.

items.prompt: Сообщается, что самолёт приземлился благополучно.
items.answer: The plane is reported to have landed safely. / It is reported that the plane landed safely.

items.prompt: Говорят, что он очень много работает.
items.answer: He is said to work a lot. / It is said that he works a lot. / He is said to work very hard.
